about: Gavin C. Gaukroger is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2019 - 2026. He works at Berger Singerman LLP, located in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, and provides legal services for issues involving Business Litigation, Intellectual Property Litigation and Securities Litigation to the surrounding community.
Gavin Gaukroger completed legal studies at The George Washington University Law School and graduated with the class of 2006. Gavin Gaukroger passed the bar in 2006.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
